items.title: Frank Amacker Interview, 1960-07-01
items.q: Joe Oliver used to play with him after Joe broke up his band.

ctx.x: Sure. Did you? Teddy Weatherford? What? What I was saying. Wonderful piano player. I got a record by them, with Louis on the cornet.

Dave Payton, you heard Dave Payton. Joe Oliver used to play with him after Joe broke up his band. You heard of him in front of them. What the shit you said? Dave Payton and Oiskin Tate, he was director at the Vendome Theatre.
He's teaching music now. I guess he gave up playing the violin.

items.title: Frank Amacker Interview, 1960-09-30
items.q: He's the one that made Louis. I guess you know that, don't you? Yeah, he made Louis.

ctx.x: Oh, I pushed a friend of mine. He's the one that made Louis. I guess you know that, don't you? Yeah, he made Louis. And Louis admits that too. He made Louis. That's a lovely player too, Joe Oliver was. He used to call him King Oliver, you know. But I never thought, I never see Joe in that light of calling him King. Freddie Kepper played with, played more principle and more ease, I thought, than all those players. Freddie Kepper. Jaws didn't swell. That's a nice thing. And Joe stayed something. That's a nice…
